title: Best Paper Award at IPIN 2026 in Rome!
summary: At IPIN 2026 the MLPS Lab has 5 papers accepted and won the best paper award for “ChronoChart: Setup-Agnostic Channel Charting for Label-Free Indoor Localization”. Thanks to all the co-authors from Fraunhofer IIS and FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg!

images.alt: Best Paper Award at IPIN 2026 in Rome!
